en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad Al Aasimy, from Ali Bin Al Hassan Al Taymuly, from Amro Bin Usman Al Azdy, from Muhammad Bin Uzafir, from Umar Bin Yazeed,
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The brisk walking in the valley of Muhassar is of a measurement of one hundred cubits’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-’Asemiy has narrated from Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Taymuliy from ‘Amr ibn ‘Uthman al-Azdiy from Muhammad ibn ‘Adhafir from ‘Umar ibn Yazid who has said the following: “
The distance to perform Sa‘y (running slowly) in Wadiy Muhassar is of one hundred yards.’”
